heroes.author: zhanyoun
heroes.credit_line: Photo: zhanyoun, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The LAMOST telescope building at Xinglong Station, photographed on site (portrait orientation).
heroes.why: Only LAMOST photo on Commons at or above 1200 px wide with a free licence (the other, LAMOST telescope org.jpg, is 800 px); portrait, 1536 px wide, and the content was not visually inspected, only matched by title and description 'lamost'.

heroes.author: panza.rayada
heroes.credit_line: Photo: panza.rayada, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Large Millimeter Telescope (Gran Telescopio Milimétrico) on Sierra Negra, Puebla.
heroes.why: Only landscape, high-resolution LMT photo in Category:Large Millimeter Telescope; others are portrait close-ups of the dish or tiny. Content matched by title/description, not visually inspected.

heroes.author: LOFAR / ASTRON
heroes.credit_line: Photo: LOFAR / ASTRON, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The LOFAR superterp, the compact core of the Low-Frequency Array near Exloo, Netherlands, with its antenna fields.
heroes.why: Official ASTRON image of the actual Exloo core, large and clearly licensed.

heroes.author: velomartinez
heroes.credit_line: Photo: velomartinez, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: Antennas of NASA's Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex at Robledo de Chavela.
heroes.why: Landscape, 4566 px, titled for the complex; alternatives were portrait (DSS-63 CC BY-SA 4.0, 3629x4838) or a CC0 aerial in portrait (2264x2464). Content matched by title, not visually inspected.

heroes.author: Generic1139
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Generic1139, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: Telescope domes near the Maunakea summit, from left the Canada-France-Hawaii, Gemini, UH 2.2 m and UK Infrared telescopes.
heroes.why: Large, landscape, CC BY 4.0 and shows several named domes on the summit; the Brian Schaller alternative is 800 px and 'free art licence'.

heroes.author: SKAO/Max Alexander
heroes.credit_line: Photo: SKAO/Max Alexander, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: Sunset panoramic view over the Meerkat National Park in the Karoo, site of the MeerKAT dish array.
heroes.why: Wide high-resolution landscape of the MeerKAT site; other MeerKAT photos are 720-1202 px. Not visually inspected, so it is unconfirmed that dishes are prominent in frame.

heroes.author: Eric Polk
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Eric Polk, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The building housing the 100-inch Hooker Telescope on Mount Wilson, California.
heroes.why: Exterior dome of the signature telescope, free licence, 3000 px wide; portrait orientation. A landscape option, Hooker_Telescope,_Mt_Wilson.jpg (3056x2448, Craig Baker, CC BY-SA 4.0), has no description so its content is unknown.

heroes.author: Lapinov
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Lapinov, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Nobeyama 45 m radio telescope at the Nobeyama Radio Observatory.
heroes.why: Largest landscape option and CC BY 4.0; others are 1022-1600 px and CC BY-SA.

heroes.author: Mike Peel
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Mike Peel, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Hale Telescope dome at Palomar Observatory.
heroes.why: Large landscape with a clear CC BY-SA 4.0 licence; the Slonecker alternative is 'copyrighted free use', not on the allowed list.

heroes.author: J.L. Dauvergne & G. Hüdepohl/ESO
heroes.credit_line: Photo: J.L. Dauvergne & G. Hüdepohl/ESO, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: Aerial view of the VLT platform on Cerro Paranal with the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes and auxiliary equipment.
heroes.why: ESO CC BY 4.0 aerial showing the whole array on its mountain. The eso.org image archive returned HTTP 503, so Commons copies of ESO images were used.

heroes.author: Maksym Kozlenko
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Maksym Kozlenko, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Parkes radio telescope dish near Parkes, New South Wales.
heroes.why: Largest landscape with a clear CC BY-SA 4.0 licence.

Best free RATAN-600 overview on Commons is RATAN_600.jpg (1024x768, CC BY 3.0, alexander s kavkaza), under the 1200 px minimum; the other free photos are 1024 px or show only the reflector plates or the receiver cabin.

heroes.author: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/T. Matsopoulos
heroes.credit_line: Photo: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/T. Matsopoulos, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: Aerial view of the Vera C. Rubin Observatory building and dome on Cerro Pachón, Chile.
heroes.why: Official NOIRLab drone photograph of the actual site, huge and CC BY 4.0.

heroes.author: Lengau
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Lengau, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Southern African Large Telescope building at Sutherland.
heroes.why: Highest-resolution SALT photo; portrait. Landscape fallbacks are lower resolution: SALT_and_the_Belt_of_Venus.jpg (1200x898, CC BY-SA 2.0, Carolina Odman).

heroes.author: SKAO
heroes.credit_line: Photo: SKAO, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: SKA-Low antennas at one of the telescope's antenna stations in Western Australia.
heroes.why: Real photograph from SKAO at full size; the other SKA-Low images on Commons are artist's impressions.

heroes.author: SKAO
heroes.credit_line: Photo: SKAO, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: An SKA-Mid dish in the Karoo with MeerKAT dishes in the background.
heroes.why: Real photograph from SKAO showing an SKA-Mid dish on site; other SKA-Mid images are artist's renders.

heroes.author: Jawed Karim
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Jawed Karim, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Very Large Array dishes on the Plains of San Agustin, New Mexico.
heroes.why: Largest landscape VLA photo with a clear free licence; the PD alternative by Jesse Allen (2400x1600) is probably a NASA Earth Observatory satellite image and was not used.
